h1: Shopify CRO to turn more visitors into buyers
overview: We study how shoppers move through your Shopify store, then fix what slows them down. We start with a review of your analytics, product pages, cart and checkout steps, and rank the changes by effort and likely payoff. Then we make the changes in a copy of your theme and track the result with your own analytics, so you can see what moved. You keep a plain-English report with the next steps.

faq: No one can honestly promise a set increase. We fix the problems your data and your pages show, set up tracking, and measure before and after. You get a clear report on what changed and what to try next.
Do you need access to my analytics?
Yes, read access to Shopify analytics and, if you use it, Google Analytics. We never ask for passwords. You add us as staff or a collaborator and can remove us whenever you like.
Will the changes affect my live store?
We make edits in a duplicate of your theme and preview them first. When you approve, we publish. If something looks wrong afterwards, we can switch back to your previous theme straight away.

Premium includes a test plan you can run with a testing app of your choice. Small stores often lack the traffic for quick results, so we focus on clear fixes first and tell you when testing makes sense.
